newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate eases 70 bps to 10.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate eases 70 bps to 10.9 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate eased 70 basis points on Tuesday to 10.9 percent amid an improved supply of kuna funds.
Dealers put trade at 24.6 million kuna, of which most were fresh call money borrowings, against demand for 30 million. Supply topped demand by 10 million.
Rates were steady at 11 percent for interbank call money and 9.0 percent charged by insurers for renewed one-week deals.
The kuna midrates for Wednesday eased slightly to 6.0321 against the dollar and to 3.5748 against the German mark. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
